products.description: Deco BE25 is TP-Link's entry Wi-Fi 7 Deco: dual-band BE5000 (4324 Mbps on 5 GHz, 688 Mbps on 2.4 GHz) with 4 streams. Each unit has two 2.5 Gbps auto-sensing WAN/LAN ports and connects up to 150 devices; multi-packs cover up to 6,600 sq. ft. Set-up and management use the Deco app with HomeShield security.
products.keywords: deco be25 budget wifi 7 mesh

products.name: TP-Link TL-SX1008 8-Port 10G Desktop/Rackmount Unmanaged Switch
products.summary: Eight-port 10GBASE-T unmanaged switch with 160 Gbps switching capacity, a smart fan and a metal desktop/rackmount case.
products.description: TL-SX1008 has eight 100M/1G/2.5G/5G/10G auto-negotiating RJ45 ports (802.3an/802.3bz), 160 Gbps of switching capacity and a 2 Mb packet buffer. A single smart fan adjusts speed with temperature, maximum power is 31.2 W, and the 294 x 180 x 44 mm metal case sits on a desk or mounts in a rack.
products.keywords: 10gbe switch 8 port unmanaged rackmount homelab

products.name: TP-Link TL-SX105 5-Port 10G Desktop Unmanaged Switch
products.summary: Fanless five-port 10GBASE-T desktop switch with 100 Gbps switching capacity.
products.description: TL-SX105 has five 100M/1G/2.5G/5G/10G auto-negotiating RJ45 ports, 100 Gbps of switching capacity and a 2 Mb packet buffer in a fanless metal desktop case. It is powered by a 12 V external adapter with 21.4 W maximum consumption.
products.keywords: 10g switch 5 port fanless desktop

products.name: TP-Link TL-SG105-M2 5-Port 2.5G Desktop Unmanaged Switch
products.summary: Fanless five-port 2.5 Gigabit unmanaged desktop switch with 25 Gbps switching capacity.
products.description: TL-SG105-M2 is a plug-and-play five-port 100M/1G/2.5G switch with 25 Gbps switching capacity, a 1.5 Mb packet buffer and 802.1p QoS in a fanless metal case. It uses a 12 V external adapter and draws 12.11 W maximum.
products.keywords: 2.5g switch 5 port cheap unmanaged

products.name: TP-Link TL-SG105PP-M2 5-Port 2.5G Switch with 4-Port PoE++
products.summary: Fanless five-port 2.5G desktop switch with four 802.3bt PoE++ ports and a 123 W PoE budget.
products.description: TL-SG105PP-M2 has five 10M/100M/1G/2.5G RJ45 ports; ports 1-4 provide 802.3af/at/bt (type 3) PoE++ from a 123 W budget, suitable for Wi-Fi 7 access points and cameras. Switching capacity is 25 Gbps and the fanless 209 x 126 x 26 mm case runs from a 53.5 V external adapter.
products.keywords: poe++ 2.5g switch 802.3bt access point wifi 7

products.name: TP-Link Omada SG3210XHP-M2 8-Port 2.5G PoE+ Managed Switch with 10G SFP+
products.summary: Omada Access Pro L2+ managed switch with eight 2.5G PoE+ ports (240 W), two 10G SFP+ uplinks and Omada SDN cloud management.
products.description: SG3210XHP-M2 has eight 10/100/1000/2500 Mbps RJ45 ports with 802.3af/at PoE+ from a 240 W budget (Fast and Perpetual PoE), two 10G SFP+ slots and RJ45 and micro-USB console ports. Switching capacity is 80 Gbps with a 12 Mbit buffer, the 1U 440 mm chassis is rack mountable with two fans, and it integrates with Omada SDN for zero-touch provisioning and cloud management.
products.keywords: omada sdn managed switch 2.5g poe+ sfp+ 10g homelab

products.name: TP-Link Omada ER707-M2 Multi-Gigabit VPN Gateway
products.summary: Fanless Omada VPN gateway with two 2.5G ports, an SFP port, four Gigabit WAN/LAN ports and 2.3 Gbps NAT throughput.
products.description: ER707-M2 is an Omada SDN wired VPN gateway with a 2.5G WAN port, a 2.5G WAN/LAN port, a Gigabit SFP WAN/LAN port, four Gigabit RJ45 WAN/LAN ports and USB for LTE backup. TP-Link rates it for about 2.35 Gbps NAT, 1.55 Gbps IPS (TCP), 650+ Mbps IPsec and 343 Mbps WireGuard, with up to 100 IPsec tunnels, SSL/OpenVPN/WireGuard servers and desktop, wall or rack mounting.
products.keywords: omada gateway vpn router multi-wan small business sdn

products.name: TP-Link Omada ER8411 VPN Gateway with 10G SFP+ Ports
products.summary: 1U Omada VPN gateway with two 10G SFP+ ports, eight Gigabit RJ45 ports, redundant power supplies and ~9.4 Gbps NAT.
products.description: ER8411 is a rack-mount Omada SDN VPN gateway with two 10GE SFP+ ports (one WAN, one WAN/LAN), a Gigabit SFP WAN/LAN, eight Gigabit RJ45 WAN/LAN ports, a console port and two USB 3.0 ports (LTE backup). TP-Link rates it for about 9.4 Gbps NAT, 9.4 Gbps IPS (TCP), ~3 Gbps IPsec and 1.4 Gbps WireGuard, with up to 300 IPsec and 500 SSL VPN tunnels and redundant dual power supplies.
products.keywords: omada er8411 10g gateway vpn router rack sfp+

products.name: TP-Link Archer TBE400UH BE6500 Wi-Fi 7 High-Gain USB Adapter
products.summary: Tri-band Wi-Fi 7 USB adapter with two high-gain antennas and a USB 3.0 cradle for Windows 10 and 11.
products.description: Archer TBE400UH adds BE6500 tri-band Wi-Fi 7 to a PC over USB, with up to 2882 Mbps on 6 GHz and 2882 Mbps on 5 GHz (802.11be) plus 2.4 GHz. It has two high-gain tri-band antennas, supports WPA3, client and hotspot modes, and ships with a USB 3.0 cradle on a 1.2 m extension cable. Windows 10 and 11 are supported.
products.keywords: usb wifi 7 adapter 6ghz high gain cradle

specs.wifiDetails: BE6500 tri-band Wi-Fi 7 (6 GHz 2882 / 5 GHz 2882 Mbps), 2 high-gain antennas, Windows 10/11

products.name: Zyxel XMG-108 8-Port 2.5G Unmanaged Switch with 10G SFP+
products.summary: Fanless eight-port 2.5G unmanaged desktop switch with an extra 10G SFP+ uplink for a NAS or backbone.
products.description: The XMG-108 is part of Zyxel's XMG100 series: eight 2.5G multi-gig ports that work over existing Cat 5e cabling plus one 10G SFP+ port for a NAS, server or uplink. It is fanless for silent operation in homes and studios and can sit on a desk or mount on a wall.
products.keywords: 2.5g switch 10g sfp+ uplink fanless unmanaged nas

products.name: Zyxel XGS1250-12 12-Port Web-Managed Multi-Gigabit Switch
products.summary: Web-managed switch with three 10G multi-gig RJ45 ports, one 10G SFP+ and eight Gigabit ports.
products.description: The XGS1250-12 combines three 100M/1G/2.5G/5G/10G RJ45 ports, one 10G SFP+ fiber port and eight Gigabit ports. Its browser GUI provides VLANs, QoS, IGMP snooping, static link aggregation, port mirroring and storm control; switching capacity is 96 Gbps (71.42 Mpps) with a 1.5 MB buffer, and a smart fan adjusts speed to temperature with an LED eco mode.
products.keywords: zyxel 10g switch web managed vlan nas homelab

products.name: Zyxel XGS1010-12 12-Port Multi-Gigabit Unmanaged Switch with 10G SFP+
products.summary: Fanless 12-port unmanaged switch with eight Gigabit, two 2.5G and two 10G SFP+ ports.
products.description: The XGS1010-12 mixes eight 1G ports, two 2.5G multi-gigabit ports and two 10G SFP+ uplinks, so a gaming PC, NAS, workstation or Wi-Fi AP can get multi-gig while the rest of the network stays on Gigabit. It is fanless and energy-saving, with high- and medium-priority ports for latency-sensitive devices.
products.keywords: unmanaged switch 10g sfp+ 2.5g fanless budget

products.name: Zyxel XMG1915-10E 8-Port 2.5G Smart Managed Switch with 2x 10G SFP+
products.summary: Compact NebulaFlex smart-managed switch with eight 2.5G ports and two 10G SFP+ ports.
products.description: The XMG1915-10E has eight 2.5G multi-gig ports and two 10G SFP+ ports in a compact desktop or wall-mount chassis. NebulaFlex lets it run standalone with a web GUI or be managed through Zyxel's license-free Nebula cloud platform alongside Zyxel APs and gateways.
products.keywords: zyxel nebula cloud managed 2.5g switch sfp+

products.name: Zyxel XMG1915-10EP 8-Port 2.5G PoE++ Smart Managed Switch with 2x 10G SFP+
products.summary: NebulaFlex smart-managed switch with eight 2.5G PoE++ (60 W) ports, a 130 W budget and two 10G SFP+ uplinks.
products.description: The XMG1915-10EP provides eight 2.5G ports with uninterrupted 802.3bt PoE++ at up to 60 W per port from a 130 W budget, plus two 10G SFP+ uplinks, for powering Wi-Fi 7 access points, PTZ cameras and IoT devices. It mounts on a desk or wall and can be managed standalone or via Zyxel's license-free Nebula cloud, including remote PoE power cycling.
products.keywords: poe++ 2.5g switch nebula wifi 7 ap sfp+

products.name: Zyxel XS1935-10 10-Port Lite-L3 Smart Managed 10G Switch
products.summary: Lite-L3 smart managed switch with eight 10G multi-gig RJ45 ports, two 10G SFP+ uplinks and 200 Gbps switching capacity.
products.description: The XS1935-10 has eight 100M/1G/2.5G/5G/10G RJ45 ports and two SFP+ uplinks with 200 Gbps of switching capacity for servers and NAS. Its web UI provides 802.1Q VLANs, 8-queue QoS per port, link aggregation, DoS prevention and IPv4/IPv6 static routing without needing a CLI.
products.keywords: 10g switch layer 3 lite static routing sfp+ homelab

products.name: Synology RT6600ax Tri-Band Wi-Fi 6 Router
products.summary: Tri-band Wi-Fi 6 router running Synology SRM, with a 2.5GbE WAN/LAN port, VLANs, VPN server features and mesh support.
products.description: The RT6600ax is Synology's tri-band Wi-Fi 6 router (2.4 GHz 600 Mbps, 5 GHz-1 4800 Mbps, 5 GHz-2 1200 Mbps) with a quad-core 1.8 GHz CPU. It has one 2.5GbE port configurable as WAN or LAN, four Gigabit ports and USB 3.2 Gen 1, supports at least 200 concurrently active devices, up to 5 separate networks and 15 SSIDs with full VLAN support, and runs Synology SRM with built-in VPN services (Site-to-Site, SSL VPN, OpenVPN, L2TP/IPsec and more), bandwidth management and parental controls. It can form a mesh with other Synology routers.
products.keywords: synology srm router wifi 6 vlan vpn plus parental controls

specs.wifiDetails: Tri-band AX6600 (2.4 GHz 600 / 5 GHz-1 4800 / 5 GHz-2 1200 Mbps), mesh capable
